# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

Prices change often, so check the current price before you buy.

## Top picks

**1. JBL Live 780NC: best noise cancelling**
- RTINGS ranks it the best ANC under $200. Its noise isolation rivals Sony and Bose flagships, and it has 60 hours of battery plus LDAC and multipoint.
- Downsides: high clamping force and thin headband padding, which can be uncomfortable on larger heads.
- It sometimes sells just under $200. RTINGS lists Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart: [RTINGS review with retailer links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**2. Soundcore Space One Pro: best battery and deal**
- Tom's Guide picks it as best under $200. It has 40 hours of battery with ANC on, LDAC and a fold-flat design.
- It lists at $199.99. Dealectric tested code AFSC20 in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, and it took the price to about $160. The code isn't valid on items already on sale, and the store's checkout has the final word.
- [Buy at Soundcore's official US store](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one-pro) (affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you)
- Downsides: no IP rating. The newer Space 2 Pro is also $199.99 but lists 30 hours with ANC on.

**3. Anker Soundcore Space Q45: best value (around $100)**
- RTINGS calls it the best headphones under $200 overall. It has amazing noise isolation and about 28 hours of battery.
- Downsides: some ANC hiss, and user reports of hinge and headband breakage.
- [RTINGS budget ANC guide](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**4. Sony ULT WEAR ($200): best for calls**
- RTINGS picks it for calls. SoundGuys measured the strongest low-frequency noise reduction of its four picks, and it has multipoint and LDAC.
- [SoundGuys-based comparison](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200), [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**5. Sennheiser Accentum Plus: best sound**
- It has a smooth, bassy tuning, a parametric EQ and 56 hours of battery.
- Downsides: its ANC is weaker, especially on engine rumble, and the headband is thinly padded.
- [RTINGS review with retailer links](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)

## Cheaper options
- **JLab JBuds Lux ANC (about $80):** 40+ hours of battery, but the weakest ANC of the group. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)
- **Anker Soundcore Life Q20 2024:** near-Q45 noise isolation and 49 hours of battery, but a hollow plastic build. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)
- **Sony WH-CH730N ($176 to $179):** effective ANC and very comfortable, but Tom's Guide thinks the US price is high. [Tom's Guide review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)

## My recommendation
- **Strongest ANC:** JBL Live 780NC, if you're okay with a snug fit.
- **Best all-round if you can use the code:** Soundcore Space One Pro at about $160.
- **Tight budget:** Soundcore Space Q45.

Only the Soundcore link goes straight to a store. The others point to review pages that list Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart, because the search results didn't include direct product URLs.
